arxiv-1809-07877.title: Lepto-philic 2-HDM + singlet scalar portal induced fermionic dark matter
arxiv-1809-07877.creator: Sukanta Dutta, Ashok Goyal, Manvinder Pal Singh
arxiv-1809-07877.description: Abstract We explore the possibility that the discrepancy in the observed anomalous magnetic moment of the muon Δ ​ a μ \Delta a_{\mu} and the predicted relic abundance of Dark Matter by Planck data, can be explained in a lepto-philic 2-HDM augmented by a real SM singlet scalar of mass ∼ \sim 10-80 GeV.

arxiv-2207-02259.title: A Furstenberg-type problem for circles, and a Kaufman-type restricted projection theorem in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3}
arxiv-2207-02259.creator: Malabika Pramanik, Tongou Yang and Joshua Zahl
arxiv-2207-02259.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Malabika Pramanik, Tongou Yang and Joshua Zahl. We resolve a conjecture of Fässler and Orponen on the dimension of exceptional projections to one-dimensional subspaces indexed by a space curve in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} . We do this by obtaining sharp L p L^{p} bounds for a variant of the Wolff circular maximal function over fractal sets for a class of C 2 C^{2} curves related to Sogge’s cinematic curvature condition. A key new tool is the use of lens cutting techniques from discrete geometry.

arxiv-2208-00489.title: Generation of a Single-Cycle Acoustic Pulse: A Scalable Solution for Transport in Single-Electron Circuits
arxiv-2208-00489.creator: Junliang Wang, Shunsuke Ota, Hermann Edlbauer, Baptiste Jadot, Pierre-André Mortemousque, Aymeric Richard, Yuma Okazaki, Shuji Nakamura, Arne Ludwig, Andreas D. Wieck, Matias Urdampilleta, Tristan Meunier, Tetsuo Kodera, Nobu-Hisa Kaneko, Shintaro Takada, Christopher Bäuerle
arxiv-2208-00489.description: Abstract The synthesis of single-cycle, compressed optical and microwave pulses sparked novel areas of fundamental research. In the field of acoustics, however, such a generation has not been introduced yet. For numerous applications, the large spatial extent of surface acoustic waves (SAW) causes unwanted perturbations and limits the accuracy of physical manipulations.

arxiv-2210-15163.creator: Alejandra D. Romero, Gabriela Oliveira da Rosa, S. O. Kepler, Paul A. Bradley, Murat Uzundag, Keaton J. Bell, J. J. Hermes, G. R. Lauffer

We present the photometric data from TESS for two known ZZ Ceti stars, PG 1541+651 and BPM 31594. Before TESS, both objects only had observations from short runs from ground-based facilities, with three and one period detected, respectively.

arxiv-2302-12597.title: Active Velocity Estimation using Light Curtains via Self-Supervised Multi-Armed Bandits
arxiv-2302-12597.creator: Website: https://siddancha.github.io/projects/active-velocity-estimation
arxiv-2302-12597.description: Abstract To navigate in an environment safely and autonomously, robots must accurately estimate where obstacles are and how they move. Instead of using expensive traditional 3D sensors, we explore the use of a much cheaper, faster, and higher resolution alternative: programmable light curtains .

arxiv-2408-05556.creator: Yisheng Yang 2 , Guodong Du 3 , Chean Khim Toa 2 , Ho-Kin Tang 3 , Sim Kuan Goh 4
arxiv-2408-05556.description: Abstract Neural architecture search (NAS) automates neural network design by using optimization algorithms to navigate architecture spaces, reducing the burden of manual architecture design. While NAS has achieved success, applying it to emerging domains, such as analyzing unstructured 3D point clouds, remains underexplored due to the data lying in non-Euclidean spaces, unlike images.

arxiv-2503-09415.title: SPARKX: A Software Package for Analyzing Relativistic Kinematics in Collision Experiments Journal: Computer Physics Communications
arxiv-2503-09415.creator: Nils Sass, Hendrik Roch, Niklas Götz, Renata Krupczak, Carl B. Rosenkvist
arxiv-2503-09415.description: Abstract SPARKX is an open-source Python package developed to analyze simulation data from heavy-ion collision experiments. By offering a comprehensive suite of tools, SPARKX simplifies data analysis workflows, supports multiple formats such as OSCAR2013, and integrates seamlessly with SMASH and JETSCAPE/X-SCAPE. This paper describes SPARKX’s architecture, features, and applications and demonstrates its effectiveness through detailed examples and performance benchmarks.

arxiv-2506-09230.title: Formal Methods Meets Readability: Auto-Documenting JML Java Code
arxiv-2506-09230.creator: Juan Carlos Recio Abad, Rubén Saborido, Francisco Chicano
arxiv-2506-09230.description: Abstract This paper investigates whether formal specifications using Java Modeling Language (JML) can enhance the quality of Large Language Model (LLM)-generated Javadocs. While LLMs excel at producing documentation from code alone, we hypothesize that incorporating formally verified invariants yields more complete and accurate results.

arxiv-2508-16904.title: Uniqueness of transonic shock solutions in general approximate nozzles for steady potential flow
arxiv-2508-16904.creator: Minghong Han, Bingsong Long, Hairong Yuan
arxiv-2508-16904.description: Abstract . We study the uniqueness of solutions with a transonic shock in a two-dimensional Riemannian manifold with a special metric, which can be regarded as an approximate model of the general physical nozzles, within a class of transonic shock solutions for steady potential flow.

plos-pone-0012130.description: PLOS ONE research article. Loss and/or degradation of nearshore habitats have led to increased efforts to restore or enhance many of these habitats, particularly those that are deemed essential for marine fishes. Copper rockfish ( Sebastes caurinus ) and lingcod ( Ophiodon enlongatus ) are dominant members

pmc-10651498.title: Effective chloride ion resistance of aluminum powder through interface electric field designing
pmc-10651498.creator: Fei Wang, Lele Tong, Dan Li, Xinlin Wei, Jian Mao
pmc-10651498.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Pure aluminium (Al) powder is widely used in aerospace fields as fuel while its corrosion mechanisms and anti-corrosion strategies are not thoroughly studied. Herein, corrosion mechanisms of Al nanoparticles are revealed by density functional theory (DFT) and experiments. Moreover, by utilizing the behaviour of ions moving in the electric field, an interfacial electric field is designed to endow spherical aluminium powder (sAl) with high anti-corrosion for chloride ions (Cl−).

pmc-11408684.title: Phase 1 dose-escalation trial evaluating a group 2 influenza hemagglutinin stabilized stem nanoparticle vaccine
pmc-11408684.creator: Joseph P Casazza, Amelia R Hofstetter, Pamela J M Costner, LaSonji A Holman, Cynthia S Hendel, Alicia T Widge, Richard L Wu, William R Whalen, Jennifer Cunningham, Anita Arthur, Xiaolin Wang, Abidemi Ola, Jamie Saunders, Floreliz Mendoza, Laura Novik, Maria C Burgos Florez, Ana M Ortega-Villa, Preet
pmc-11408684.description: The relative conservation of the influenza hemagglutinin (HA) stem compared to that of the immunodominant HA head makes the HA stem an attractive target for broadly protective influenza vaccines. Here we report the first-in-human, dose-escalation, open-label trial (NCT04579250) evaluating an unadjuvanted group 2 stabilized stem ferritin nanoparticle vaccine based on the H10 A/Jiangxi-Donghu/346/2013 influenza HA, H10ssF, in healthy adults.

pmc-11419479.title: Effect of health literacy on hospital readmission among patients with heart failure: A protocol for systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11419479.creator: Lei Xiao, Fan Zhang, Cong Cheng, Ningling Yang, Qi Huang, Yuan Yang
pmc-11419479.description: Background:Patients with heart failure have a high rate of health literacy deficiency, and their hospital readmission is a great burden. Whether health literacy affects hospital readmission remains controversial.Objective:To investigate the impact of health literacy on hospital readmission among heart failure patients.

pmc-11615693.title: Effects of glucokinase haploinsufficiency on the pancreatic β‐cell mass and function of long‐term high‐fat, high‐sucrose diet‐fed mice
pmc-11615693.creator: Ikumi Shigesawa, Akinobu Nakamura, Yuki Yamauchi, Shinichiro Kawata, Asuka Miyazaki, Hiroshi Nomoto, Hiraku Kameda, Yasuo Terauchi, Tatsuya Atsumi
pmc-11615693.description: Aims/IntroductionWe previously showed that glucokinase haploinsufficiency improves the glucose tolerance of db/db mice by preserving pancreatic β‐cell mass and function. In the present study, we aimed to determine the effects of glucokinase haploinsufficiency on the β‐cell mass and function of long‐term high‐fat, high‐sucrose (HFHS) diet‐fed mice.

pmc-12199923.title: A Case Report of the Synchronous Occurrence of Ovarian Granulosa Cell Tumour and Malignant Endometrial Polyp with Immunohistochemical Expression of Hormone Receptors and Biomarkers p-53 and Ki-67
pmc-12199923.creator: Krum Vladov, Ekaterina Uchikova, Maria Koleva-Ivanova, Kamen Yamakov, Veselin Belovezhdov, Gita Yamakova-Vladova, Eleonora Hristova-Atanasova, Ichiro Onoyama
pmc-12199923.description: Background and Clinical Significance: Abnormal uterine bleeding during the postmenopausal years is a pathological sign that may be due to simultaneous intrauterine and ovarian pathology. Granulosa cell tumours of the ovary are malignant neoplasms producing oestradiol, which leads to the abnormal proliferation of the endometrium, precancerous lesions, and endometrial carcinoma type I.

pmc-12431607.title: Interface Design of VR Driverless Vehicle System on User-Prioritized Experience Requirements
pmc-12431607.creator: Haibin Xia, Yu Zhang, Xuan Li, Dixin Liu, Wanting Wang, Radu Comes, Dorin-Mircea Popovici, Calin Gheorghe Dan Neamtu, Jing-Jing Fang
pmc-12431607.description: The prioritization of user requirements is neglected in most existing interface designs for driverless vehicle systems, which may incur safety risks, fragmented user experiences, development resource wastage, and weakened market competitiveness. Accordingly, this paper proposes a hybrid interface design method for a virtual reality (VR) driverless vehicle system by combining a A-KANO model and system usability scale (SUS).

pmc-12647572.title: Changes in blood concentration of tranexamic acid in dialysis and non-dialysis patients undergoing cardiac surgery: a prospective observational cohort study
pmc-12647572.creator: Takahiro Tamura, Tatsuro Yokoyama, Tsuyoshi Nakai, Yasuhiro Miyagawa, Kimitoshi Nishiwaki
pmc-12647572.description: The pharmacokinetics of tranexamic acid (TXA), used during cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) surgery, in patients receiving maintenance hemodialysis remain unclear. This prospective study compared serum tranexamic acid (TXA) concentrations following bolus administration and subsequent intensive care unit (ICU) admission in patients undergoing cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB), including those receiving maintenance hemodialysis and those not on dialysis.

pmc-13069171.title: Antidiabetic drug and chronic respiratory disease in type 2 diabetes: a network meta-analysis and Mendelian randomization analysis
pmc-13069171.creator: Ikramulhaq Patel, Yin-He Chai, Zi-Qi Wang, Hui Xu, Jin-Yan Zhang, Rafael Simo, Xing-Yao Tang, Jian-Bo Zhou
pmc-13069171.description: Background:Multimorbidity management is crucial in aging populations, particularly for chronic respiratory diseases (CRDs) and diabetes. Their coexistence increases exacerbation and mortality risks. Antidiabetic drugs may differentially impact respiratory outcomes.Objectives:To evaluate the effects of antidiabetic drugs on CRDs in individuals with type 2 diabetes (T2D).Design:Systematic review with conventional and network meta-analyses (NMAs).

pmc-13397690.title: Infantile brainstem tumors presenting with recurrent pneumonia and dysphagia: a report of two cases and literature review
pmc-13397690.creator: Wei Wang, Yang Huang, Wenhua Deng, Yabin Wu
pmc-13397690.description: BackgroundBrainstem gliomas rarely occur during infancy and typically present without the classic neurological signs seen in older children. Instead, affected infants develop nonspecific symptoms, recurrent pneumonia, dysphagia, and feeding difficulties that closely mimic common pediatric conditions, leading to diagnostic delay. We report two infants with brainstem tumors whose initial presentations were attributed entirely to respiratory or gastrointestinal disease.

pmc-13447492.title: Euhabitability: A New Term to Aid in the Search for Life in Addition to the Habitable Zone Framework
pmc-13447492.creator: Donald M Glaser, Stephanie Olson, Svetlana Berdyugina, Paul Byrne, Peter Cawood, Manasvi Lingam, Jacob Lustig-Yaeger, Tilman Spohn
pmc-13447492.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The search for life on exoplanets is difficult due to observational limitations stemming from vast separating distances. The Habitable Zone (HZ) is a simplifying framework for identifying exoplanets that may be suitable for life, given our observational limitations. The HZ framework is built on many simplifying assumptions and only attempts to bound the circumstellar regions where surface oceans are not precluded. In other words, HZ exoplanets are where surface oceans are possible, not necessarily where life is possible.

pmc-13463296.title: Integrating perfluorocarbon and type-I photosensitizer into a single molecule: a phenothiazine-based platform for hypoxia-tolerant PDT
pmc-13463296.creator: Ziqi Zou, Meiying Liu, Kun Zhang, Peng Luo, Tongsheng Huang, Jianwen Tian, Xiaoyong Zhang, Zhihui Kuang, Yen Wei
pmc-13463296.description: Hypoxia-induced resistance remains a major obstacle in photodynamic therapy (PDT) due to the oxygen dependency of conventional type-II photosensitizers. To tackle this issue, we developed a phenothiazine-based small molecule (PFI) that integrates intrinsic oxygen-carrying perfluoroalkyl chains with type-I photodynamic functionality.
